'''Herra Ros''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[engineer]] who, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], wished to defect from one faction to the other. She offered information in exchange for an annual salary.<ref name="Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission is available to members of both fractions in the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Consequently, Herra defects to either the Empire or the Republic depending on the player's fraction.<ref name="Mission" />
